hero.credit: The Battles of Hogen and Heiji. Rogers Fund, 1957. The Metropolitan Museum of Art. [1]
hero.description: “The Rebellions of the Hogen and Heiji Eras,” Edo period (1615–1868), 17th century. Progressing from right to left, the screen illustrates a number of legendary fighting scenes as narrated in “The Tale of the Hogen Rebellion.” The rebellion, which occurred in central Kyoto in the summer of 1156, involved a dispute over succession between Emperor Go-Shirakawa and former Emperor Sutoku.
